nodes.label: Support Channels
nodes.rationale: GitHub Issues for bugs (bug label) and feature requests (enhancement label, describing the use case not just the solution); GitHub Discussions for how-do-I questions and architectural advice — question issues are converted to discussions. Best-effort response times; PRs with tests land fastest.

nodes.label: Security Vulnerability Reporting
nodes.rationale: Never open a public issue; use GitHub private vulnerability reporting or email the maintainers per SECURITY.md.
